title: Phase Transition
description: A change between macroscopic phases, characterized in equilibrium theory by nonanalytic thermodynamic behavior in the appropriate infinite-system limit. Suitable order parameters distinguish many conventional phases, but no local order parameter describes every transition.

relations.note: Equilibrium phase comparisons use thermodynamic equilibrium states.
Sharp thermodynamic singularities arise in the infinite-system limit for ordinary equilibrium models.
Bose–Einstein condensation is an example of an equilibrium phase transition.
